card.name: Commas and spaces closing an inserted phrase
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a blank space right after a noun phrase or name, where a comma or closing mark is expected next. It appears in general web prose, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Comma after a name or date
modes.description: A comma that follows a name, year or list item and opens or closes a side phrase.
modes.example: When Chao had written about the device in 1994 <<,>> it was largely ignored.

modes.label: Space before closing punctuation
modes.description: A space token after a term, just before a comma, quote or clause that continues the sentence.

card.plain: It fires at small breaks, like commas and spaces, that come right after a name or phrase in ordinary web text.
